ir.name: hyperparam_tuning_M2_variant_repaired_divergent_transform
ir.intuition: Smooth asymmetric softplus transform on normalized advantage gap difference with margin shift and scale, preserving pairwise logsigmoid structure.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon = 1e-6
norm_adv = sqrt(mean(advantage_gap * advantage_gap))
norm_adv = max(norm_adv, epsilon)
diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm_adv
margin = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('margin', 0.1))
scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))
softplus_pos = softplus(scale * (diff - margin))
softplus_neg = softplus(scale * (-margin))
transformed_diff = softplus_pos - softplus_neg
loss = -logsigmoid(transformed_diff) * weight
return sum(loss) / max(sum(weight), epsilon)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']

    norm_adv_squared = ops.mean(ops.mul(advantage_gap, advantage_gap))
    norm_adv = ops.sqrt(norm_adv_squared)
    norm_adv = ops.maximum(norm_adv, eps)

    diff = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm_adv)

    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))
    margin = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('margin', 0.1))

    softplus_pos = ops.softplus(ops.mul(scale, ops.sub(diff, margin)))
    softplus_neg = ops.softplus(ops.mul(scale, ops.neg(ops.ones_like(lpw) * margin)))
    transformed_diff = ops.sub(softplus_pos, softplus_neg)

    loss = ops.mul(ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(transformed_diff)), weight)
    loss_sum = ops.sum(loss)
    total_weight = ops.sum(weight)
    return ops.div(loss_sum, ops.maximum(total_weight, eps))
